test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: maths
question: In ΔABC, AB = 20 cm, BC = 7 cm and CA = 15 cm. Side BC is produced to D such that ΔDAB sim ΔDCA. DC is equal to:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of corresponding sides k = AB/CA = 20/15 = 4/3.

In similar triangles ΔDAB ∼ ΔDCA, the ratio of segments on the produced side is DB/DC = k².

DB/DC = (4/3)² = 16/9.

The difference in ratio parts is 16 − 9 = 7 parts, which corresponds to BC = 7 cm.

Since 7 units = 7 cm, then 1 unit = 1 cm.

Length of DC = 9 units = 9 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: AB = 20 cm, BC = 7 cm, CA = 15 cm. Side BC is produced to D such that ΔDAB ∼ ΔDCA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ebbbe90fc3607b847c41ceffdb469f6237917b2f52e0e52c8841e386b5bda25.png] 

Formula: For similar triangles ΔDAB ∼ ΔDCA, the ratio of corresponding sides is equal.

⇒ DA/DC = DB/DA = AB/CA

⇒ AB/CA = 20/15 = 4/3

⇒ DA/DC = 4/3 ⇒ DA = (4/3)DC

⇒ DB/DA = 4/3 ⇒ DB = (4/3)DA

⇒ DB = (4/3) × (4/3)DC = (16/9)DC

⇒ Since D is on BC produced, DB = BC + DC

⇒ (16/9)DC = 7 + DC

⇒ (16/9)DC − DC = 7

⇒ (7/9)DC = 7

⇒ DC = 9 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 9 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

AA Similarity Criterion

Two triangles are similar if two corresponding angles are equal; in this case, ∠D is common and ∠DAB = ∠DCA.

Side Ratios in Similarity

When triangles are similar, the ratio of any two corresponding sides is constant (e.g., AB/AC = BD/AD = AD/CD).

Geometric Mean Property

In this configuration, the side AD is the geometric mean of the segments on the produced line: AD² = DB × DC.</p
